turns.text: Hi, you've reached Copper Wok Eastside. What can I do for you?
Hey, do you deliver to my area? I want the shrimp fried rice and the pad see ew and the kung pao chicken.
One thing: my husband is allergic to sesame. Is that a problem?
Thanks for telling me. Just to confirm, that's a sesame allergy for your husband?
I checked our allergen list: the shrimp fried rice has no sesame listed, though it's prepared in a shared kitchen, so cross-contact is possible.
Happy to. What address should we deliver to?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's shrimp fried rice and pad see ew and kung pao chicken, $52.50 with the delivery fee. We'll text you when the driver leaves.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
